epistemic_status: Post-outcome descriptive identity decomposition. Source daily GPS and ERA5 observations and previous adjusted source results are already observed. No new causal confirmation or predictive benchmarks.
biological_question: Why do two independent mule deer sources show nearly identical raw positive daylength/night-relative-speed associations but different conditional daylength relationships when accounting for Tmax and antecedent P−ET0? Evaluate all original eligible taxa rather than positive mule deer alone.
unchanged_source_support: All original individual-year local-solar day/nights from frozen source scripts. Select original one fix per UTC hour by timestamp alone. Straight-line step rates from qualified 0.5–2h intervals; >=3 GPS intervals in both day/night, >=10 original source local days in each individual calendar-year, original source season/year assembly. Original q and q~daylength group means and admission counts replay before weather.
weather: Original first-party daily source ERA5 code from scripts/movebank_wyoming_daily_climate_20261023.py, same original 1-degree GPS-observed climate cell/date and 30d past-only P−ET0/100. Use all fixed original source observed cells including source holds, no interpolation or cherry-pick.
joint_year_gate: At least 15 complete matched animal observation days, >=0.5h original observed daylight span, residual L SD>=0.1h, conditional Tmax SD>=0.5°C, conditional P−ET0/100 SD>=0.1 and 2-control matrix non-collinear (det ratio >=0.01). These are unchanged from previous source-locked daily climate slope estimator.
model: For every qualified animal-year on IDENTICAL source days, q=alpha + beta_L*L + beta_T*Tmax + beta_W*(antecedent 30d P−ET0/100) + residual. Compute marginal b_raw=Cov(L,q)/Var(L), environmental calendar coupling gamma_T=Cov(L,Tmax)/Var(L), gamma_W=Cov(L,W)/Var(L). Verify exact omitted-variable identity b_raw=beta_L + beta_T*gamma_T + beta_W*gamma_W, requiring tolerance 1e-8.
interpretation: T and W terms are MATHEMATICAL seasonal covariance contributions, not physical mediation or causal explained shares. Do not interpret b_L as directly experienced sunlight mechanism. No extrapolation beyond sources.
aggregation: Within source species, equal animal-year means within each animal then equal animal means within original source. Different species, source years, grids are not independent global replicates. Preserve all 4 Utah and 2 Wyoming taxa, support failures and sign reversals.
uncertainty: If >=5 qualified animals, 2000 deterministic animal-cluster bootstrap per contribution/source/taxon (seed 20261019), 95% percentile CI. No animal-day p-values, no raw GPS/date/source animal identities or 1° cell keys in artifacts.
decision: If original known source joint L estimator does not replay to 1e-10 or original provider MD5 mismatches, source HOLD, no new ecological claims. Do not change original q, L, climate outcomes in PR #268.
